headline: Paraguay Orders Arrest of Ex-President's Brother in Ueno Bank Probe
summary: Paraguayan prosecutors ordered the preventative detention of Francisco Peña, brother of former President Santiago Peña, as part of an investigation into the regulatory intervention of Ueno bank.
why: Legal scrutiny and intervention into commercial banks can affect domestic banking liquidity and credit counterparty risk in Paraguay.

impacts.name: Ueno bank
impacts.why: Criminal warrants against leadership figures follow regulatory intervention of the bank.
